```plato

// A rectangle with arbitrary rotation: Size gives the full width and height
// along the box's local axes, rotated by Rotation about Center
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oriented_bounding_box).
type OrientedBox2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, ICentered2D, IContainsPoint2D, INearestPoint2D, ISupport2D
{
    Center: Point2D;
    Size: Size2D;
    Rotation: Angle;
}
```
